title: Two-Ball Pound Series
description: Dribbling two balls at once in simultaneous and alternating patterns builds coordination and a stronger weak hand.

content.objective: Build symmetrical control by forcing both hands to work independently and together.
content.setup: Each player has two balls and stands in an athletic stance with space around them.
instructions: Dribble both balls at the same height and the same time for 20 touches.
Alternate the balls so one is up while the other is down for 20 touches.
Add a low pound dribble with both balls below the knee for 15 seconds.
Finish with 15 seconds of alternating dribbles at the fastest controlled speed.
coachingPoints: Keep the eyes up, not on either ball.
Use even pressure from both hands at the same rhythm.
Stay in an athletic stance, not standing tall.
commonMistakes: Letting one ball drift higher than the other.
Losing the stance and standing straight up.
Speeding up until control breaks down, instead of building speed gradually.
content.safety: Give each player a few metres of open space to recover a loose ball safely.
